title: ReTaCo: Residual-Target Control for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39275v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated prefixes with token-level teacher feedback, but transmitting or storing the teacher's full-vocabulary distribution at every token is costly. Entropy-aware OPD (EOPD) adds forward supervision to reverse KL to help the student recover plausible tokens it underestimates, using only the teacher's top-$k$ probabilities to limit cost. Because EOPD renormalizes these probabilities, its target assigns no mass to the omitted vocabulary. We prove that the resulting loss keeps pushing the student's top-$k$ mass toward one even after the student matches the teacher's relative probabilities within the top-$k$ set, so the teacher itself is not a stationary point whenever the omitted tokens have positive teacher probability. translated_title: ReTaCo：面向在线策略蒸馏的残差目标控制
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在学生模型自身生成的前缀上，利用教师模型的token级别反馈进行训练，但在每个token处传输或存储教师模型的完整词表分布代价高昂。熵感知OPD（EOPD）在反向KL散度基础上增加了前向监督，以帮助学生模型恢复其低估的合理token，并仅使用教师模型的top-k概率来限制成本。由于EOPD会对这些概率进行重新归一化，其目标分布对被省略的词表部分不分配任何概率质量。我们证明，即使学生模型已经在top-k集合内匹配了教师模型的相对概率，由此产生的损失仍会持续将学生模型的top-k概率质量推向1，因此只要被省略的token具有正的教师概率，教师模型本身就不是损失函数的驻点。我们提出ReTaCo（Residual-Target Control，残差目标控制），该方法单独保留top-k token，并将其余token归并为一个残差符号，同时将此fo……
tldr: 论文提出ReTaCo方法，通过单独保留教师模型top-k token并将其余词表归并为单个残差符号，解决了熵感知在线策略蒸馏（EOPD）因概率重归一化导致教师模型本身非损失驻点的理论缺陷，实现了低成本且更准确的师生分布匹配。
en_tdlr: ReTaCo fixes the theoretical flaw of entropy-aware on-policy distillation (EOPD)—where renormalized top-k targets make the teacher itself a non-stationary point—by keeping top-k tokens individually and grouping the remaining vocabulary into a single residual symbol, enabling accurate yet low-cost student-teacher distribution matching.
